other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: For research (no output flag, generated claudedocs/research_*.md) and troubleshoot (REPORT.md in an unnamed directory) the contract name/dir is unspecified, so two parallel workers in one worktree would share one return-contract.yaml in the same directory, violating WC-11 and letting the coordinator read the wrong worker's status.
